text: Hey! Don't think you're going to get away with that, thief!
source_text: Hey! Don't think you're going to get away with that, thief!

text: 嘿！你以为我没有看到你在干什么？！小偷！
source_text: 嘿！你以为我没有看到你在干什么？！小偷！

text: We're closed. Come back around four o'clock.
source_text: We're closed. Come back around four o'clock.

text: 酒吧关门了。四点左右再来。
source_text: 酒吧关门了。四点左右再来。

text: Welcome to the Skum Pitt. What can I do ya for?
source_text: Welcome to the Skum Pitt. What can I do ya for?

text: 欢迎来到斯卡姆·匹特。我能为你做些什么？
source_text: 欢迎来到斯卡姆·匹特。我能为你做些什么？

text: 好吧，那么你想知道些什么？
source_text: 好吧，那么你想知道些什么？

text: What's the scoop on this town?
source_text: What's the scoop on this town?

text: 镇子里有没有有趣的事？
source_text: 镇子里有没有有趣的事？

text: Who's the dangerous-looking stranger in the corner?
source_text: Who's the dangerous-looking stranger in the corner?

text: 那角落里凶神恶煞的人是谁？
source_text: 那角落里凶神恶煞的人是谁？

text: 【Neal looks at you quizzically for a moment.】 Haven't you ever seen a bar# before, stranger? This is my place, the Skum Pitt. You buy drinks here. And you# tip me.
source_text:
【Neal looks at you quizzically for a moment.】 Haven't you ever seen a bar
# before, stranger? This is my place, the Skum Pitt. You buy drinks here. And you
# tip me.

text: 【尼尔上下打量了你一阵子。】你从没来过酒吧吗，我没见过你？这是我的地盘，斯卡·匹特。买饮料的话，要收小费。
source_text: 【尼尔上下打量了你一阵子。】你从没来过酒吧吗，我没见过你？这是我的地盘，斯卡·匹特。买饮料的话，要收小费。

text: Uh, right. I knew that. So, can I get a drink?
source_text: Uh, right. I knew that. So, can I get a drink?

text: 啊，好的。我知道了。那么，给我来一杯？
source_text: 啊，好的。我知道了。那么，给我来一杯？

text: Yeah. Um, can I get some other information?
source_text: Yeah. Um, can I get some other information?

text: 耶，恩，我能问些其他的消息吗？
source_text: 耶，恩，我能问些其他的消息吗？

text: What's that trophy on the shelf?
source_text: What's that trophy on the shelf?

text: 在那架子上的是什么玩意儿？
source_text: 在那架子上的是什么玩意儿？

text: Well, just over there to the west of us is Gizmo's casino. I'd be# surprised if you didn't know about it; most of the people here are the ones who# just finished losing their money there. Over in the other part of town you got# Killian's general store, and Marcelles's Crash House. Killian's a good guy, runs# a straight joint, carries everything you need. The Crash House is where you sleep# it off when you've been in here for too long. 【Neal chuckles.】
source_text:
Well, just over there to the west of us is Gizmo's casino. I'd be
# surprised if you didn't know about it; most of the people here are the ones who
# just finished losing their money there. Over in the other part of town you got
# Killian's general store, and Marcelles's Crash House. Killian's a good guy, runs
# a straight joint, carries everything you need. The Crash House is where you sleep
# it off when you've been in here for too long. 【Neal chuckles.】

text: 好吧，从我们这儿往西边是吉斯莫的赌场。我敢赌一把你知道的；好多赌客在那里输光了身上的钱。镇子里还有基利安的杂货店，玛塞尔的旅店。基利安是个好家伙，他的店里有你想要的任何东西。旅店是你“睡觉”的好地方，你会流连忘返。【尼尔吃吃的笑了。】
source_text: 好吧，从我们这儿往西边是吉斯莫的赌场。我敢赌一把你知道的；好多赌客在那里输光了身上的钱。镇子里还有基利安的杂货店，玛塞尔的旅店。基利安是个好家伙，他的店里有你想要的任何东西。旅店是你“睡觉”的好地方，你会流连忘返。【尼尔吃吃的笑了。】

text: Thanks. Can I get a drink?
source_text: Thanks. Can I get a drink?

text: Thanks for the information. See you around.
source_text: Thanks for the information. See you around.

text: Fella's called Tycho. Apparently a ranger from back east or something.# Pretty nasty fighter, from what I hear, but a straight-up character.
source_text:
Fella's called Tycho. Apparently a ranger from back east or something.
# Pretty nasty fighter, from what I hear, but a straight-up character.

text: 小伙子被称为提可。显然是从东方来的一个流浪者。我听说他是一个相当野蛮的斗士。
source_text: 小伙子被称为提可。显然是从东方来的一个流浪者。我听说他是一个相当野蛮的斗士。

text: Mind if I ask some other questions?
source_text: Mind if I ask some other questions?

text: 是否介意我问些别的问题？
source_text: 是否介意我问些别的问题？

text: Oh, them. They're the Skulz. They're a local gang. All the riff-raff.#Sometimes they start fights or cause a little trouble. Usually Killian keeps them# in line, though.
source_text:
Oh, them. They're the Skulz. They're a local gang. All the riff-raff.
#Sometimes they start fights or cause a little trouble. Usually Killian keeps them
# in line, though.

text: 哦，他们。他们是骷髅党。这一带的犯罪团伙。都是些流氓。他们时常为些小事而抄家伙，不过基利安一般都能让他们安分守己。
source_text: 哦，他们。他们是骷髅党。这一带的犯罪团伙。都是些流氓。他们时常为些小事而抄家伙，不过基利安一般都能让他们安分守己。

text: That's not a trophy, it's an urn. It contains my wife's ashes -# besides this bar, it is the most important thing in my life.
source_text:
That's not a trophy, it's an urn. It contains my wife's ashes -
# besides this bar, it is the most important thing in my life.

text: 那并不是装饰物，而是个骨灰盒。里面盛着我老婆的骨灰－是有这个酒吧之外我生命中最重要的东西了。
source_text: 那并不是装饰物，而是个骨灰盒。里面盛着我老婆的骨灰－是有这个酒吧之外我生命中最重要的东西了。

text: Come back when you've got some money.
source_text: Come back when you've got some money.

text: What happened to that trophy you used to have up there?
source_text: What happened to that trophy you used to have up there?

text: 放在那上面的玩意儿是啥？
source_text: 放在那上面的玩意儿是啥？

text: Thank you. You can't know what this means to me. You'll never pay# for a drink in this bar again.
source_text:
Thank you. You can't know what this means to me. You'll never pay
# for a drink in this bar again.

text: 谢谢你。你绝不会知道这对我有多重要。以后你想在这里喝酒都算我的。
source_text: 谢谢你。你绝不会知道这对我有多重要。以后你想在这里喝酒都算我的。

text: I've got your urn back for you.
source_text: I've got your urn back for you.

text: 我把你的“老婆”找回来了。
source_text: 我把你的“老婆”找回来了。

text: Some slime stole it. It wasn't a trophy, it was an urn. It contained my wife's ashes - besides this bar, it was the most important thing in my life.
source_text: Some slime stole it. It wasn't a trophy, it was an urn. It contained my wife's ashes - besides this bar, it was the most important thing in my life.

text: 哪些个杂碎偷走了它。那并不是个装饰品，那是个骨灰盒。我老婆住在里面－除了这个酒吧那是我生命中最重要的东西了。
source_text: 哪些个杂碎偷走了它。那并不是个装饰品，那是个骨灰盒。我老婆住在里面－除了这个酒吧那是我生命中最重要的东西了。

text: Get the hell outta here you goddamn punks! If any of ya ever touch her# again I'll kill the whole lot o' ya!
source_text:
Get the hell outta here you goddamn punks! If any of ya ever touch her
# again I'll kill the whole lot o' ya!

text: 你这该死的废物给我他妈的滚出去！你要再敢碰下她我就把你整个废了！
source_text: 你这该死的废物给我他妈的滚出去！你要再敢碰下她我就把你整个废了！

text: The day I can't handle little shits like you is the day I die!
source_text: The day I can't handle little shits like you is the day I die!

text: 哪天我不能收拾像你这种狗屎的时候就是我死的那天！
source_text: 哪天我不能收拾像你这种狗屎的时候就是我死的那天！

text: What the hell ya doin'? We're closed. Get on out of here!
source_text: What the hell ya doin'? We're closed. Get on out of here!

text: 你他妈的在做什么？酒吧关门了。滚蛋！
source_text: 你他妈的在做什么？酒吧关门了。滚蛋！

text: Ya damn kids, I'll show you a thing or two!
source_text: Ya damn kids, I'll show you a thing or two!

text: 小兔崽子，我得教你点做人的原则！
source_text: 小兔崽子，我得教你点做人的原则！
